QuestInfo.name: Korean Folk Town : Through the Sky
QuestInfo.0: How about going to the Korean Folk Town through the sky?
QuestInfo.1: Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the skypath and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Camila said she'll give me a few essential items for the trip. What must those be?
QuestInfo.2: Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the skypath and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Okay, so I first go from #bEllinia#k to #bOrbis#k, then to #bLudibrium#k? And once I get there, I'm supposed to walk my way down there through #bHelios Tower#k. That's pretty far...

yes.0: Okay, now I'll tell you how to get to Korean Folk Town through the sky. First, head over to the station in #bEllinia#k. The ship that heads to #bOrbis#k should leave every 15 minutes. The station at Orbis is gigantic, and once there, you'll need to switch the flight to the ship that heads to #bLudibrium#k. At Ludibrium, it features two humongous towers, and you need to head over to #bHelios Tower#k and descend your way all the way down until you reach Korean Folk Town.
yes.1: Alright, now talk to me once more so I can give you all the necessary items for the travel.

no.0: Please let me know when you're ready.

1.0: This ticket will enable you to get on board for the flight. Please use it wisely.
